description: This file defines the RelationRepository interface for managing RelationEntity objects in a SQL database, including custom query methods for relation retrieval and deletion, as well as batch processing.
external_methods: findNextBatch(UUID fromId, String fromType, String relationTypeGroup, String relationType, UUID toId, String toType, int batchSize)

classes.name: RelationRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for RelationEntity, extending JpaRepository and JpaSpecificationExecutor, with custom query methods for relation management.

methods.name: findAllByFromIdAndFromTypeAndRelationTypeGroup
methods.description: Finds all RelationEntity objects matching fromId, fromType, and relationTypeGroup.

methods.name: findAllByFromIdAndFromTypeAndRelationTypeGroupIn
methods.description: Finds all RelationEntity objects matching fromId, fromType, and any of the specified relationTypeGroups.

methods.name: findAllByFromIdAndFromTypeAndRelationTypeAndRelationTypeGroup
methods.description: Finds all RelationEntity objects matching fromId, fromType, relationType, and relationTypeGroup.

methods.description: Finds all RelationEntity objects matching toId, toType, and relationTypeGroup.

methods.name: findAllByToIdAndToTypeAndRelationTypeGroupIn
methods.description: Finds all RelationEntity objects matching toId, toType, and any of the specified relationTypeGroups.

methods.name: findAllByToIdAndToTypeAndRelationTypeAndRelationTypeGroup
methods.description: Finds all RelationEntity objects matching toId, toType, relationType, and relationTypeGroup.

methods.name: findRuleNodeToRuleChainRelations
methods.description: Retrieves relations where relationTypeGroup is 'RULE_NODE' and toType is 'RULE_CHAIN', filtered by ruleChainType, with pagination.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a RelationEntity object to the database.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a RelationEntity by its composite key.

methods.name: deleteByFromIdAndFromType
methods.description: Deletes relations with specified fromId and fromType.

methods.name: deleteByToIdAndToTypeAndRelationTypeGroupIn

methods.name: deleteByFromIdAndFromTypeAndRelationTypeGroupIn
methods.description: Deletes relations with specified fromId, fromType, and relationTypeGroups.

methods.name: findNextBatch
methods.description: Retrieves the next batch of relations after specified fromId, toId, and relation details, for batch processing.
